"remaining_gap_or_prior_bridge": "Alman–Lian–Tran Wn identifies lensless diagrams modulo motions/lens resolution, ordered by crossing breaks without dividing-line restriction. Endpoint pairing identifies this with Lam Pn: every matching has a lensless diagram, and the defining equivalence preserves/exhausts diagrams with each pairing. Both cover relations are the same lensless one-crossing resolutions, and adjoining a bottom agrees. Thus Lam1406.5671 Theorem1 on P-hat_n is exactly the target, predating this discovery (22Jun2014). Proof text uses affine Bruhat lifting and parity involutions; no novelty. Full diagram-equivalence foundation cited by Lam not independently rebuilt, figures not visually reviewed.",
